verdict.rationale: Marqeta is a card-issuing SaaS platform that handles customer and transaction data, so a no-AI-training privacy posture is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, data-use policy, or AI-training restriction. The MCP server and sandbox materials concern other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
